eligibility.quote: The problem was that serial.block() is called before serial.open() in hydro branch kobuki_driver/kobuki.cpp line 93

loudness.quote: I have a new version of mangled output - this time all is CAPTIAL LETTERS! :-) ... Same result though - terminal get's unresponsive.

resolution.quote: Thus, the proposed patch is going to call serial.block() function after serial.open() in kobuki.cpp

notes: Calling serial.block() before serial.open() invoked tcsetattr on an uninitialized file descriptor, corrupting the terminal.
